verdict.rationale: Jules explicitly provides a diff of agent changes for review/approval before creating a PR, with docs stating you can 'quickly browse and approve code edits' and then 'Jules creates a PR of the changes' only after approval; this is corroborated by community reports of reviewing PRs before merge. missing for 10: no independent hands-on account specifically confirming the diff-before-PR approval step (vs plan approval) works smoothly.
